shared_elements: incised hatched or cross-hatched texturing to indicate fur or surface pattern
justification: The only real correspondence is that both surfaces involve a large feline-like animal rendered with fine incised hatching to suggest hide or mane, which is a fairly generic device. A is a single monumental head/creature carved in the round with no narrative context, while B is a multi-figure narrative low relief with a wheeled vehicle, archer, harnessed horses and collapsing lions arranged in a horizontal register — no shared scene, relationships or composition.
